correctness.rationale: Exact factorial matching probabilities and independent Dirichlet spacings give product Haar–Gamma factorial moment measures; beta tail estimates give full finite-measure tightness. The local internal-edge event has probability O(K^2/n); Acan Theorem 4.1 excludes all larger-length degree <=K chords whp. The published theorem was inspected including its O(k^2/n) bad-chord estimate. A standalone standard-library enumerator gives 85 exact grouped and 9 seeded grouped checks. The infinite result rests on the proof, not the tests.

value.rationale: The degree of a chord is a graph-theoretic vulnerability measure. Previously known Poisson count limits leave the location and physical size of exceptional vertices undetermined. The new uniform-location/Gamma-mark factorization supplies exact degree-conditioned physical length laws and an extreme-length cdf at the natural microscopic scale, useful for geometric localization and sampling of low-degree chord-graph structures, not a routine renamed scalar count.
